Provenance.aiDisclosure: No seed, model, sampler or generation record exists for this asset -- it predates art/build/*.build.json provenance tracking. TownLayout2D.cs's own doc calls this and its siblings 'the pre-pivot SDXL set': still drawn live today as the Tavern building (TownLayout2D.Venues 'tavern' spriteId, resolved through TownAssets2D.ForVenue) per the 2026-08-01 owner ruling to keep this SDXL exterior look over the town2d pixel-art alternative. recolor-forge-roof.py samples its own target hue directly from this file's shingled roof, which is the only other corroborating evidence in-repo that this is SDXL-era art -- but no seed/model/sampler was ever captured for this specific file, so nothing is invented here -- recorded honestly as unreproducible-legacy (U9, R9) rather than fabricated.
